subject: Error in mkRespMod -- response must be numeric

messages.author: 579026dcfa74d335
messages.subject: Error in mkRespMod -- response must be numeric
parts:
Hi --  I am totally new to R and not much more advanced in stats, but am trying to learn it to complete my master's thesis.  I am trying to run glmer tests and have the basic format, but am getting the following error message:

Error in mkRespMod(fr, family = family) : response must be numeric

My code is:  
 test1=glmer(V12~V10+(1|V4),family=poisson)

The V's stand for the variable names:  the program doesn't seem to recognize the text names, but only the column order.

I searched online to try to figure this out, but am coming up empty.  

Thank you for any insight you can provide.  

Tania
